title: Data center infrastructure trends and supply chain tracking
discussion_signal: The post links AI data-center expansion to semiconductors, advanced packaging, copper, electrical equipment, grid expansion, and supply-chain bottlenecks. It also treats infrastructure investment as an opportunity, supplying a market-positive counter-frame to local cost and capacity concerns.
